FunctionBody:
CatoNetworksEvents_CL
| where not(disabled)
| where tostring(column_ifexists('event_type', '')) == 'Security'
| extend _CatoAppStack = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists('app_stack', '')))
| where gettype(_CatoAppStack) == 'array' and set_has_element(_CatoAppStack, 'DNS')
| extend _CatoQuery = trim(@'\s+', tostring(column_ifexists('dns_query', ''))), _CatoQueryType = toupper(tostring(column_ifexists('dns_record_type', ''))),
    _CatoReply = toupper(tostring(column_ifexists('dns_reply_code', ''))), _CatoAnswers = tostring(column_ifexists('dns_answer', ''))
| where isnotempty(_CatoQuery)
// Sentinel's DCR maps source epoch-millisecond time into native TimeGenerated.
// A retained original time takes precedence; time_str is only an alternative source clock.
| where tostring(column_ifexists("event_sub_type", "")) != "Flow"
| where tostring(column_ifexists("source", "")) != "cato:hec:flows"
    and tostring(column_ifexists("sourcetype", "")) != "cato:hec:flows"
    and tostring(column_ifexists("Type", "")) != "cato:hec:flows"
| extend _CatoCommonRawCount = column_ifexists("event_count", dynamic(null)),
    _CatoCommonEpoch = tostring(column_ifexists("time", dynamic(null))),
    _CatoCommonTimeStr = tostring(column_ifexists("time_str", "")),
    _CatoCommonMappedTime = todatetime(column_ifexists("TimeGenerated", datetime(null))),
    _CatoCommonExtra = todynamic(column_ifexists("AdditionalFields", "{}"))
| extend _CatoCommonCountText = tostring(_CatoCommonRawCount),
    _CatoCommonCount = tolong(_CatoCommonRawCount),
    _CatoCommonPrimaryTime = iff(isempty(_CatoCommonEpoch), _CatoCommonMappedTime,
        iff(_CatoCommonEpoch matches regex @"^-?[0-9]+$", unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(_CatoCommonEpoch)), datetime(null))),
    _CatoCommonAlternativeTime = iff(_CatoCommonTimeStr matches regex @"^-?[0-9]+$",
        unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(_CatoCommonTimeStr)), todatetime(_CatoCommonTimeStr))
| where isnull(_CatoCommonRawCount)
    or (_CatoCommonCountText matches regex @"^[0-9]+$" and _CatoCommonCount between (1 .. 2147483647))
| extend _CatoCommonSourceTime = coalesce(_CatoCommonPrimaryTime, _CatoCommonAlternativeTime)
| where isnotnull(_CatoCommonSourceTime)
| where (isnull(starttime) or _CatoCommonSourceTime >= starttime)
    and (isnull(endtime) or _CatoCommonSourceTime <= endtime)
| extend
    TimeGenerated = _CatoCommonSourceTime,
    EventStartTime = _CatoCommonSourceTime,
    EventEndTime = _CatoCommonSourceTime,
    EventCount = toint(coalesce(_CatoCommonCount, long(1))),
    EventVendor = "Cato Networks",
    EventProduct = "Cato Cloud",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventOriginalType = tostring(column_ifexists("event_type", "")),
    EventOriginalSubType = tostring(column_ifexists("event_sub_type", "")),
    EventOriginalUid = tostring(column_ifexists("event_id", "")),
    EventUid = tostring(column_ifexists("event_id", "")),
    EventMessage = tostring(column_ifexists("event_message", "")),
    AdditionalFields = iff(gettype(_CatoCommonExtra) == "dictionary", _CatoCommonExtra, dynamic({})),
    Dvc = "Cato Cloud",
    DvcOriginalAction = tostring(column_ifexists("action", "")),
    DvcScopeId = tostring(column_ifexists("account_id", "")),
    DvcScope = tostring(column_ifexists("account_name", ""))
| extend AdditionalFields = bag_merge(AdditionalFields, iff(isempty(tostring(column_ifexists("pop_name", ""))),
    dynamic({}), bag_pack("CatoPopName", tostring(column_ifexists("pop_name", "")))))
| project-away _CatoCommon*
// Reply-code fields are documented only for these DNS-capable Security subtypes.
| where tostring(column_ifexists('event_sub_type', '')) in (
    'Agentic Threat Prevention', 'DNS Protection', 'Dynamic Prevention', 'IPS',
    'Internet Firewall', 'Private Access Policy', 'Suspicious Activity', 'WAN Firewall')
| extend EventSchema = 'Dns', EventType = 'Query', DnsQuery = iff(_CatoQuery endswith '.' and _CatoQuery != '.', substring(_CatoQuery, 0, strlen(_CatoQuery) - 1), _CatoQuery),
    EventSubType = 'response',
    _CatoSrcIp = tostring(column_ifexists('src_ip', '')), _CatoDstIp = tostring(column_ifexists('dest_ip', '')),
    _CatoSrcPort = toint(column_ifexists('src_port', '')), _CatoDstPort = toint(column_ifexists('dest_port', '')),
    _CatoDuration = toint(column_ifexists('duration_ms', '')), _CatoProtocol = toupper(tostring(column_ifexists('ip_protocol', ''))), _CatoUser = tostring(column_ifexists('user_name', '')),
    _CatoTypeCodes = dynamic({'A':1,'NS':2,'MD':3,'MF':4,'CNAME':5,'SOA':6,'MB':7,'MG':8,'MR':9,'NULL':10,'WKS':11,'PTR':12,'HINFO':13,'MINFO':14,'MX':15,'TXT':16,'RP':17,'AFSDB':18,'SIG':24,'KEY':25,'AAAA':28,'LOC':29,'SRV':33,'NAPTR':35,'KX':36,'CERT':37,'DNAME':39,'OPT':41,'APL':42,'DS':43,'SSHFP':44,'IPSECKEY':45,'RRSIG':46,'NSEC':47,'DNSKEY':48,'DHCID':49,'NSEC3':50,'NSEC3PARAM':51,'TLSA':52,'SMIMEA':53,'HIP':55,'CDS':59,'CDNSKEY':60,'OPENPGPKEY':61,'CSYNC':62,'ZONEMD':63,'SVCB':64,'HTTPS':65,'SPF':99,'EUI48':108,'EUI64':109,'TKEY':249,'TSIG':250,'IXFR':251,'AXFR':252,'MAILB':253,'MAILA':254,'ANY':255,'URI':256,'CAA':257,'AVC':258,'DOA':259,'AMTRELAY':260,'RESINFO':261}),
    _CatoCodeNames = dynamic({'0':'NOERROR','1':'FORMERR','2':'SERVFAIL','3':'NXDOMAIN','4':'NOTIMP','5':'REFUSED','6':'YXDOMAIN','7':'YXRRSET','8':'NXRRSET','9':'NOTAUTH','10':'NOTZONE','11':'DSOTYPENI','16':'BADVERS','17':'BADKEY','18':'BADTIME','19':'BADMODE','20':'BADNAME','21':'BADALG','22':'BADTRUNC','23':'BADCOOKIE'}),
    _CatoCodeNumbers = dynamic({'NOERROR':0,'FORMERR':1,'SERVFAIL':2,'NXDOMAIN':3,'NOTIMP':4,'REFUSED':5,'YXDOMAIN':6,'YXRRSET':7,'NXRRSET':8,'NOTAUTH':9,'NOTZONE':10,'DSOTYPENI':11,'BADVERS':16,'BADSIG':16,'BADKEY':17,'BADTIME':18,'BADMODE':19,'BADNAME':20,'BADALG':21,'BADTRUNC':22,'BADCOOKIE':23})
| extend DnsQueryType = coalesce(toint(_CatoTypeCodes[_CatoQueryType]), toint(extract(@'^(?:TYPE)?([0-9]+)$', 1, _CatoQueryType))),
    DnsResponseCode = coalesce(toint(_CatoCodeNumbers[_CatoReply]), iff(_CatoReply matches regex @'^[0-9]+$', toint(_CatoReply), int(null))),
    SrcIpAddr = iff(isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_CatoSrcIp)) and _CatoSrcIp !contains '/', _CatoSrcIp, ''), DstIpAddr = iff(isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_CatoDstIp)) and _CatoDstIp !contains '/', _CatoDstIp, ''),
    SrcPortNumber = iff(_CatoSrcPort between (0 .. 65535), _CatoSrcPort, int(null)), DstPortNumber = iff(_CatoDstPort between (0 .. 65535), _CatoDstPort, int(null)),
    DnsResponseName = iff(_CatoAnswers == '[]', '', _CatoAnswers), EventOriginalResultDetails = tostring(column_ifexists('dns_reply_code', '')),
    DvcOriginalAction = tostring(column_ifexists('action', '')), DvcAction = tostring(column_ifexists('action', '')),
    SrcUsername = iff(_CatoUser matches regex @'^([^\s@\\]+@[^\s@\\]+|[^\s@\\]+\\[^\s@\\]+|[^\s@\\]+)$', _CatoUser, ''),
    SrcGeoCountry = tostring(column_ifexists('src_country', '')), DstGeoCountry = tostring(column_ifexists('dest_country', '')),
    DnsNetworkDuration = iff(_CatoDuration >= 0, _CatoDuration, int(null)),
    NetworkProtocol = case(_CatoProtocol in ('6', 'TCP'), 'TCP', _CatoProtocol in ('17', 'UDP'), 'UDP', '')
| extend DnsQueryType = iff(DnsQueryType between (0 .. 65535), DnsQueryType, int(null)), DnsResponseCode = iff(DnsResponseCode between (0 .. 4095), DnsResponseCode, int(null))
// Mandatory DNS outcomes require a recognized response; unknown/reserved codes remain raw.
| where isnotempty(tostring(_CatoCodeNames[tostring(DnsResponseCode)]))
| extend _CatoTypeNames = dynamic({'1':'A','2':'NS','3':'MD','4':'MF','5':'CNAME','6':'SOA','7':'MB','8':'MG','9':'MR','10':'NULL','11':'WKS','12':'PTR','13':'HINFO','14':'MINFO','15':'MX','16':'TXT','17':'RP','18':'AFSDB','24':'SIG','25':'KEY','28':'AAAA','29':'LOC','33':'SRV','35':'NAPTR','36':'KX','37':'CERT','39':'DNAME','41':'OPT','42':'APL','43':'DS','44':'SSHFP','45':'IPSECKEY','46':'RRSIG','47':'NSEC','48':'DNSKEY','49':'DHCID','50':'NSEC3','51':'NSEC3PARAM','52':'TLSA','53':'SMIMEA','55':'HIP','59':'CDS','60':'CDNSKEY','61':'OPENPGPKEY','62':'CSYNC','63':'ZONEMD','64':'SVCB','65':'HTTPS','99':'SPF','108':'EUI48','109':'EUI64','249':'TKEY','250':'TSIG','251':'IXFR','252':'AXFR','253':'MAILB','254':'MAILA','255':'ANY','256':'URI','257':'CAA','258':'AVC','259':'DOA','260':'AMTRELAY','261':'RESINFO'})
| extend DnsQueryTypeName = case(isnotempty(tostring(_CatoTypeNames[tostring(DnsQueryType)])), tostring(_CatoTypeNames[tostring(DnsQueryType)]), isnotnull(DnsQueryType), strcat('TYPE', tostring(DnsQueryType)), ''),
    EventResultDetails = iff(isnotempty(tostring(_CatoCodeNumbers[_CatoReply])), _CatoReply, tostring(_CatoCodeNames[tostring(DnsResponseCode)])),
    EventResult = iff(DnsResponseCode == 0, 'Success', 'Failure'),
    SrcUsernameType = iff(isnotempty(SrcUsername), tostring(column_ifexists('src_endpoint_type', '')), ''),
    SrcHostname = '', DstHostname = '',
    NetworkProtocolVersion = iff(
        (isnotempty(SrcIpAddr) and isnull(parse_ipv4(SrcIpAddr))) or (isnotempty(DstIpAddr) and isnull(parse_ipv4(DstIpAddr))), 'IPv6', 'IPv4')
| extend Domain = tostring(column_ifexists('dest_domain', '')), Src = SrcIpAddr, Dst = DstIpAddr, IpAddr = SrcIpAddr, Hostname = SrcHostname, User = SrcUsername, Duration = DnsNetworkDuration
| where isempty(srcipaddr) or srcipaddr == '*' or SrcIpAddr == srcipaddr
| where isempty(tostring(domain_has_any)) or tostring(domain_has_any) == '[]' or DnsQuery has_any (domain_has_any)
| where isempty(responsecodename) or responsecodename == '*' or EventResultDetails =~ responsecodename
| where isempty(response_has_ipv4) or has_ipv4(DnsResponseName, response_has_ipv4) or has_ipv4_prefix(DnsResponseName, response_has_ipv4)
| where array_length(response_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DnsResponseName, response_has_any_prefix)
| where isempty(eventtype) or eventtype == '*' or EventType =~ eventtype
| extend AdditionalFields = bag_merge(AdditionalFields, bag_pack('CatoApplicationName', tostring(column_ifexists('application_name', ''))))
| project-away _Cato*
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_merge(AdditionalFields, pack_all(true)), AdditionalFields)
